declaration.purpose: Observe Strategy H's already-finished research decisions on future data only, beside Strategy A and Strategy E, without changing either of them.

upstream.refusal_reason: A forward shadow launched on the superseded window rule would be observing a valuation the repository has already shown to be wrong on VRRM, so the engine refuses to launch under any contract other than D5_D2R_V1.

decision_states.APPROVE: the only state that may become a paper entry candidate
decision_states.WATCH: an observed candidate with no position and no return claim
decision_states.REJECT: not selected, no position; kept in the cohort so a rejection is falsifiable
decision_states.NOT_DECISION_ELIGIBLE: an upstream layer abstained; not part of the forward cohort

position_rule.why_not_defined: Strategy A sizes from risk_v1 (0.5% of equity per 1R) and needs an initial stop; Strategy E sizes 1/3 of equity per slot and needs a same-session exit. D6 produces neither an entry level, a stop nor an exit (its own `d6_never_produced` list says so), so neither existing convention can be applied to H without inventing a parameter H's research never produced. D7 v1 therefore records an APPROVE as an entry candidate and refuses to open a position until a sizing contract is separately frozen.
position_rule.execution_convention_when_defined: the A/E paper convention, unchanged: a decision settled after the close fills at the next regular session's open through app.broker.sim.SimBroker under app.execution.config execution_v0

transitions.cause_required: D3->D4->D5->D6 re-evaluation on new material evidence

price_monitoring.store: H's own append-only session store; the frozen HIST-V1 b_e0 mirror is never written to

outcomes.path_metrics_use: daily high/low of the sessions inside the horizon

preregistered_forward_questions: does an issuer whose Bull leg sat below its price (IDCC, TP2 -16.6%) cross it
does any stated invalidation condition fire
does an issuer whose RECENT_6M window governed get re-rated back toward its FULL_2Y range (the only item that tests D5-D2R)

cohort_tags.INITIAL_D7_COHORT: the eight decision-eligible issuers present at launch
cohort_tags.NEW_FORWARD_CANDIDATE: an issuer admitted after launch through the frozen D1->D6 pipeline
